stories.t: A shark went astray and captured Korea's heart - will she finally make it back to sea?
stories.s: More than a million people flocked to Busan to catch a glimpse of the female dusky shark they called Bukangi.
stories.tz: 误入歧途的鲨鱼俘获了韩国民众的心——它最终能重回大海吗？
stories.sz: 超过一百万人涌向釜山，只为一睹那头被他们亲切称为“布康吉”的雌性暗色真鲨的风采。

stories.t: Who are the candidates in Brazil's presidential election?
stories.s: Voters in Sunday's election are choosing between two very different candidates, as Americas correspondent Ione Wells reports from Rio de Janeiro.
stories.tz: 巴西总统选举候选人都有谁？
stories.sz: 美洲事务记者伊奥娜·韦尔斯自里约热内卢报道，周日大选的选民将在两位截然不同的候选人之间做出选择。

stories.t: Ukraine’s military says Starlink satellite connection stable after recent restrictions
stories.s: But Elon Musk, whose company SpaceX owns Starlink, accuses Ukrainian military of violating ⁠the company’s terms Ukraine’s military has a “stable connection to Starlink”, the Ukrainian government said, 10 days after its ability to use the…
stories.tz: 乌克兰军方称“星链”卫星连接在近期限制后已恢复稳定
stories.sz: 但拥有“星链”的太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）负责人埃隆·马斯克指责乌克兰军方违反了公司的使用条款。乌克兰政府表示，在乌方使用星链受限10天后，乌军与“星链”保持着“稳定的连接”……

stories.t: Protests roil France once again as police seek to quell violence
stories.s: Hundreds of thousands turned out across France to protest everything from the lack of school funding to economic inequality. Police also were out in force to prevent a repeat of last week's violence.
stories.tz: 法国再度爆发抗议活动，警方力图平息暴力事件
stories.sz: 数十万民众走上法国各地街头，抗议从学校资金短缺到经济不平等的多项问题。警方也出动大量警力，以防止上周的暴力事件再次发生。

stories.t: Why a far-right cabinet minister in Israel has Netanyahu's ear
stories.s: Israel's most far-right cabinet minister helped dictate hardline policies toward Palestinians in recent years. Benjamin Netanyahu vows to give him a senior position if Netanyahu is reelected next week.
stories.tz: 为何以色列极右翼内阁部长备受内塔尼亚胡器重
stories.sz: 以色列极右翼的内阁部长近年来协助制定了针对巴勒斯坦人的强硬政策。本雅明·内塔尼亚胡承诺，如果自己在下周的选举中再次当选，将为他安排高级职务。

stories.t: More than one million Lula supporters rally on eve of Brazilian election runoff
stories.s: Nearly 159 million people to head to polls on Sunday in battle between leftwing incumbent and Flávio Bolsonaro More than one million supporters of Brazil’s leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, have streamed on to Rio’s most…
stories.tz: 巴西大选决胜轮前夕：逾百万卢拉支持者集会
stories.sz: 在左翼现任总统与弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的对决中，近1.59亿选民将于周日走上投票箱前。逾百万巴西左翼总统卢拉·达席尔瓦的支持者涌入里约热内卢……

stories.t: Government says protests across France 'went well' despite nearly 1,000 arrests
stories.s: Hundreds of thousands marched across France on Saturday protesting the rising cost of living and a lack of government resources for essential services like schools. While demonstrations in Paris started peacefully they ended with a heavy…
stories.tz: 法国政府称全国抗议活动“进展顺利”，尽管近千人被捕
stories.sz: 周六，法国数十万人走上街头，抗议生活成本上升以及政府对学校等基本公共服务投入不足。尽管巴黎的游行开始时较为和平，但最终在严密戒备下结束……

stories.t: Hundreds of thousands march in France as protests take place across Europe – as it happened
stories.s: French police have made 1,000 arrests and Italian officers have raided homes in Milan, with protests also taking place in Spain and Albania Jesse, 40, a charity worker from the north of Paris, had turned out for the street march. She said…
stories.tz: 法国数十万人游行，欧洲多国爆发抗议——事件实时追踪
stories.sz: 法国警方已逮捕1000人，意大利执法人员在米兰搜查多处住宅，西班牙和阿尔巴尼亚也爆发了抗议活动。来自巴黎北部、40岁的慈善工作者杰西走上街头参与游行，她表示……

stories.t: Fireworks and tear gas as protesters and riot police clash in Paris
stories.s: The BBC's Europe correspondent reports from Paris where mostly peaceful protests turned into unrest after nightfall.
stories.tz: 巴黎示威者与防暴警察冲突，现场燃放烟花并释放催泪瓦斯
stories.sz: BBC欧洲事务记者自巴黎发回报道，当地本以和平为主的抗议活动在夜幕降临后演变为骚乱。

stories.t: France: Watching the Post-Riot Protests
stories.s: After the French protests turned into riots last weekend, the curfews, and then the alleged racist mass shooting yesterday on the outskirts of Paris, there has been much anxiety, planning and preparation ahead of today's protests.
stories.tz: 法国：关注骚乱后的抗议活动
stories.sz: 在上周末法国抗议活动演变为骚乱、实施宵禁，以及昨日巴黎郊区发生涉嫌种族主义的大规模枪击事件后，各方对今日的抗议活动充满焦虑，并进行了大量规划和筹备。

stories.t: “Witkoff should step down” says Ukraine Committee Chief
stories.s: Ukraine’s access to Starlink and Starshield satellite links has been restored to the speeds it had before restrictions that disrupted front-line operations for more than a week, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Saturday.
stories.tz: 乌克兰委员会负责人称“维特科夫应当辞职”
stories.sz: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基周六表示，乌克兰对“星链”和“星盾”卫星链路的访问权限已恢复至此前速度，此前长达一周多的限制曾干扰前线行动。

stories.t: Thousands take to Tel Aviv's streets for protests against Netanyahu
stories.s: Thousands marched against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government in Tel Aviv on Saturday – just three days before Israel's general election – demanding accountability for the failure to prevent a Hamas-led attack on October 7…
stories.tz: 数千人走上特拉维夫街头抗议内塔尼亚胡
stories.sz: 就在以色列大选前三天，数千名示威者周六在特拉维夫游行，抗议总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的政府，要求其为未能阻止10月7日哈马斯主导的袭击承担责任……

stories.t: Musk says SpaceX did restrict Starlink, as Ukraine says the tech has been restored
stories.s: Musk said Ukraine had been violating Starlink's terms by using it for military activity, as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said normal operating speeds have returned.
stories.tz: 马斯克称SpaceX确实限制了星链，乌克兰称技术已恢复
stories.sz: 马斯克表示，乌克兰将星链用于军事活动，违反了相关使用条款。与此同时，乌克兰总统泽连斯基宣布星链已恢复正常运行速度。

stories.t: Yemen's Houthi rebels claim new attacks on oil facilities and airports across Saudi Arabia
stories.s: Yemen’s Iran-allied Houthi rebels said they launched attacks at Saudi oil facilities and airports on Saturday while Yemen’s Saudi-backed government ​said the ‌group also fired three ballistic missiles at coast guard sites in ⁠the port city…
stories.tz: 也门胡塞武装声称对沙特多地的石油设施和机场发动新袭击
stories.sz: 也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装周六称其对沙特的石油设施和机场发动了袭击；与此同时，获得沙特支持的也门政府表示，该组织还向港口城市的海警基地发射了三枚弹道导弹……

stories.t: Two rescued after Nairobi building collapse with five still missing
stories.s: Police have launched a manhunt for the building's owner and contractor after the multi-storey building collapsed while still under construction.
stories.tz: 内罗毕楼房倒塌致2人获救，仍有5人失踪
stories.sz: 这栋多层建筑在施工期间发生倒塌，警方已对该建筑的所有者和承包商展开全城搜捕。

stories.t: Fire engulfs Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
stories.s: Police in the southern German state of Bavaria have detained a 33-year-old German man following the fire.
stories.tz: 希特勒山顶度假胜地“鹰巢”突发大火
stories.sz: 德国南部巴伐利亚州警方已拘留了一名33岁的德国男子。

stories.t: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
stories.s: Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.
stories.tz: 希特勒山顶“鹰巢”度假地发生火灾后一人被捕
stories.sz: 大约200名应急人员被部署前往扑灭这座纳粹独裁者在德国阿尔卑斯山的宅邸大火。

stories.t: Nine killed and 40 injured after gunmen open fire at church funeral in Jordan
stories.s: Footage broadcast on state TV shows three attackers approaching Greek Orthodox church and firing shots Nine people have been killed after gunmen opened fire at a funeral at a church in Jordan in a rare attack ⁠on the country’s Christian…
stories.tz: 约旦一教堂葬礼发生枪击事件，致9死40伤
stories.sz: 国家电视台播出的画面显示，三名袭击者接近一座希腊正教会教堂并开枪。约旦发生罕见的针对该国基督徒的袭击，教堂葬礼上的枪击事件已造成9人死亡……

stories.t: Turkey's new deal on Mediterranean maritime boundaries with Libya is exacerbating issues with Greece and the EU
stories.s: Turkey and Libya plan to redraw maritime boundaries in the Mediterranean as part of a new economic corridor. This has sparked strong protests from Greece, and has also drawn the European Union into the conflict.
stories.tz: 土耳其与利比亚达成的新地中海海上边界协议加剧了与希腊和欧盟的矛盾
stories.sz: 作为新经济走廊的一部分，土耳其和利比亚计划重新划分地中海海上边界。此举引发了希腊的强烈抗议，并将欧盟卷入了这场冲突。

stories.t: Kim Jong-un crosses newly opened bridge into China
stories.s: North Korean leader travels over New Yalu River Bridge to meet senior Communist party member Kim Jong-un has visited China, inaugurating a bridge that connects the two countries and saying he hopes to expand cooperation with his neighbour.…
stories.tz: 金正恩经新建大桥跨过边境进入中国
stories.sz: 朝鲜最高领导人经新鸭绿江大桥赴华会见中共高级官员。金正恩已访问中国，为连接两国的桥梁剪彩，并表示希望扩大与邻国的合作。

stories.t: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
stories.s: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.
stories.tz: 乌克兰称“星链”连接在网络限制后“现已恢复稳定”
stories.sz: “星链”连接速度变慢曾对乌克兰的军事和无人机行动造成了一周的影响。

stories.t: Gunmen open fire at a church during a funeral in Jordan, killing 7 and wounding 40
stories.s: Footage broadcast on Jordanian state television showed three gunmen firing shots at a Greek Orthodox church in the city of Karak on Friday.
stories.tz: 约旦一教堂在葬礼期间遭枪手袭击，造成7人死亡40人受伤
stories.sz: 约旦国家电视台播出的画面显示，周五在卡拉克市，三名枪手向一座希腊东正教教堂开枪射击。

stories.t: European student protests take aim at Serbia's elections
stories.s: Students have been protesting across Europe. In Serbia, they've selected candidates to run for parliament in Sunday's elections. And they're aiming to end 14 years of government by the populist leader Aleksandar Vucic.
stories.tz: 欧洲学生抗议活动将矛头指向塞尔维亚选举
stories.sz: 欧洲各地爆发了学生抗议活动。在塞尔维亚，他们推选了候选人参加周日的议会选举，旨在结束民粹主义领导人亚历山大·武契奇长达14年的统治。

stories.t: No unions, low taxes: why some of Britain’s top chefs are opening outposts in Gulf states
stories.s: Leading restaurateur says Gulf countries actively help businesses set up, while east Asia has a better work ethic Some of London’s top restaurants are opening branches in Dubai because of a “tax tsunami” in the UK and better work ethic…
stories.tz: 没有工会、税率低：英国顶级名厨为何纷纷在海湾国家开设分店
stories.sz: 知名餐饮业者称海湾国家积极协助企业落户，而东亚的工作伦理更好。由于英国的“税收海啸”以及更好的工作伦理，伦敦的一些顶级餐厅正在迪拜开设分店……

stories.t: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
stories.s: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
stories.tz: 肯尼亚一名65岁女性成为第二名死于埃博拉的患者
stories.sz: 她是首位死者的近亲属，首位死者是一名曾前往刚果民主共和国的男性。

stories.t: British woman dies trying to save sons on Bahamas snorkelling trip
stories.s: Mother, 36, died after current off North Bimini reportedly swept away two boys, who were later rescued, police say A British woman has died in the Bahamas while trying to rescue her two sons after a current swept them away as they were…
stories.tz: 英国女子在巴哈马浮潜时为救儿子不幸身亡
stories.sz: 警方称，这名36岁的母亲在北比米尼附近水域因洋流卷走两个男孩而前往施救，最终不幸身亡，两名男孩随后获救。一名英国女子在巴哈马……

stories.t: Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland
stories.s: Three people - two women and one man - have been released, and one person remains in custody, gardaí say.
stories.tz: 爱尔兰致命纵火案后三人未被起诉获释
stories.sz: 爱尔兰警察局表示，已有三人（两女一男）获释，另有一人仍被拘留。

stories.t: Iran trying harder to target US personnel in Middle East, intelligence chief warns
stories.s: The warning comes as the US State Department makes adjustments to staffing at diplomatic posts in the region.
stories.tz: 情报主管警告称：伊朗正加紧在中东针对美方人员
stories.sz: 在此警告发出之际，美国国务院正对该地区外交机构的人员配置进行调整。

stories.t: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
stories.s: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.
stories.tz: 白宫称梅拉尼娅·特朗普为“濒临绝境”的乌克兰城市促成休战
stories.sz: 乌克兰和俄罗斯证实了俄占奥列什基市的休战协议，当地居民此前靠吃花园里的杂草维生。

stories.t: Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels
stories.s: Taiz, a city in southwestern Yemen, faces a severe water crisis as Houthi rebels backed by Iran tighten their encirclement. The city has struggled with water issues for over a decade, but the situation has worsened in recent weeks.
stories.tz: 受胡塞武装围困的也门城市饮用水供应日益枯竭
stories.sz: 也门西南部城市塔伊兹正面临严峻的水危机，在伊朗支持的胡塞武装收紧包围圈之际，该情况愈发严重。该市十多年来一直饱受水资源问题困扰，但最近几周情况进一步恶化。

stories.t: Why Russia's arrest of Japanese journalist is the latest sign of deteriorating ties between the countries.
stories.s: Japan is demanding access to a journalist who was arrested by Russian security services. The Kremlin claims that Japan is using journalists as spies.
stories.tz: 俄罗斯逮捕日本记者：两国关系恶化的最新迹象
stories.sz: 日本正要求探视一名被俄罗斯安全部门逮捕的记者。克里姆林宫则声称日本正在利用记者进行间谍活动。

stories.t: How Brazil's changing working class is reshaping the presidential race
stories.s: Calls for change present a challenge to President Lula in the second round of the election on Sunday.
stories.tz: 巴西不断变化的工人阶级如何重塑总统大选
stories.sz: 变革呼声给周日第二轮选举中的卢拉总统带来了挑战。

stories.t: The rise of AI election ads in US midterms campaign
stories.s: BBC Verify has tracked dozens of AI ads to assess how they are being used by campaigns in the midterms.
stories.tz: AI选举广告在美国中期选举竞选中的兴起
stories.sz: BBC核查栏目追踪了数十个AI广告，以评估竞选阵营在中期选举中如何使用这些广告。
